# Contract: docker-compose-patterns

Third-party skill from [docker/skills](https://github.com/docker/skills) (Apache-2.0, Docker, Inc.), skills-bundle snapshot 2026-11-13. SumitCraft set the folder name and the description so the skill fills one gap (Local multi-service setup with Compose). The method is upstream. Category: engineering. Kind: scripted.

## Purpose
Create or debug a Docker Compose file: services, health checks, dependencies, volumes, networks, and a dev override.

## Use it for
- "write a compose file for this app and its database"
- "this compose stack does not become healthy"

## Not for
- deploy to production
- a threat model of a running service (security-threat-model)

## Accepted inputs
A project that needs more than one local container.

## Deliverables
compose.yaml (and an override when the skill calls for one) plus a verification note.
